reference_audit.rule: Every asserted fact in a factual candidate is present in the question or allowed evidence with matching statistic, temporal scope, and qualification. Truthful-omission candidates contain no additional episode event. Expected unsupported candidates each contain a deliberate, identified violation.
reference_audit.v6_disposition: V6 remains failed and is not rescored; its exposed cases are development evidence only.
reference_audit.freshness: V7 uses new identifiers, evidence packets, quantities, wording, and candidate responses.

protected_causal_rule: A protected causal case requires exact material_error and causal_overclaim labels. Mechanism identification remains part of composite/core scoring but is not duplicated in the protected subgate when a supported mechanism is accompanied by an unsupported identity.
changes_from_v6: Fresh reference-audited cases only. No model, prompt, endpoint, threshold, schema, rubric, isolation, protected rule, or retry change.
qualification_rule: Both passes independently satisfy every gate.
uncertainty_rule: Report pass-specific Wilson 95 percent intervals; zero observed errors never means zero population error.
retry_policy: Transport-only bounded retry; never retry a usable or inconvenient judgment.
hard_stop: If either pass fails, retain the result and end Luna qualification iteration for the submission; do not score study responses.
activation_condition: Both fresh passes qualify and the result manifest is committed before any study scoring.
